thread_title: S. leucophylla hurricane creek white clone G Baldwin Co, AL
breadcrumb: S. leucophylla hurricane creek white clone G Baldwin Co, AL

posts.body_html:
Here's one of the original, authentic hurricane creek white clones that came from the HCW site before it was destroyed. I haven't ever photo-documented this clone because it's not as crazy white as the others, but compared to regular leucophyllas, it's still noteworthy and will definitely be preserved for the long haul to protect genetic diversity.
